description: Shipped the first DashPass game backend one week early, serving 2,000 weekly players through Go services, gRPC/Protobuf APIs, Kotlin server-driven UI contracts, and Cassandra storage

Architected the backend foundation for all future DashPass games, adopted by 5 games, with reusable execution graphs, game-agnostic components, and storage interfaces, requiring just 22 lines of per-game registration code

Enabled 2 engineers new to the codebase to independently build game backends in 3 days each, versus 6 weeks for the original, by authoring an AI skill that codified the system’s architecture, code templates, and implementation steps

Diagnosed 4 silent production defects through distributed traces, uncovering subscription-check inconsistencies during platform migration and resolving win-write failures across iOS and Android without a client release

Adapted cross-border order synchronization for a new resell model with fulfillment checks and conditional order creation in Go within a MySQL-backed e-commerce and payment system processing 10M+ daily transactions
Reduced directly managed dependencies by 90% across 7 Go services by migrating to a library management framework and restructuring service registration, RPC integrations, and Kafka consumers
Restored notification-service deployments in 2 weeks for 100+ internal users as the service’s primary contact, correcting deployment incompatibilities and repairing its failing test environment

Orchestrated campaign-specific order flows supporting nearly 100,000 free flag distributions for Singapore National Day through configurable shop/item access controls and notification email links, extensible to future campaigns
Commenced role after early graduation; concluded tenure upon Master's program admission
Benchmarked 20+ forecasting models for S&P 500 and global indices, comparing Bayesian VAR, GARCH, and neural approaches through RMSE and MAE for return and volatility predictions
Backtested long-short momentum and risk-parity strategies over 10+ years, evaluating risk-adjusted performance through Sharpe ratios
Streamlined time-series experimentation with pandas, scikit-learn, and PyTorch to prepare data, train forecasting models, and compare predictive accuracy
Built Swift prototypes to explore Apple Vision Pro capabilities, combining interactive 3D content, location data, and external API integration
Investigated undocumented visionOS behavior through reverse-engineering to establish implementation approaches for mixed-reality interactions
Structured prototype functionality into modular components, shortening integration time by 30% for subsequent development
Developed a scheduler for customer self-booking and automated SMS/email confirmations based on shop availability, among 9+ features from a 4-engineer startup later acquired by Highland Creek Partners
Cut data retrieval latency by 80% on tables with 10K+ rows by redesigning query architecture and implementing keyset pagination in Java, jOOQ, and PostgreSQL for application list views
Revamped the repair-order closing workflow for mobile and web use, improving cross-device usability and restructuring the code for easier maintenance
Constructed firmware architecture enabling rapid microcontroller onboarding, reducing deployment time by 30%
Orchestrated reliability improvements with fallback data buffering to ensure resilience during network disruptions
Automated fault detection alerts via WhatsApp/Telegram APIs, cutting user response time from 8 hours to minutes
